title: Park Madison Partners podcast: Real Estate Capital with Nancy Lashine
summary: In a Real Estate Capital podcast episode from Park Madison Partners, JLL Spark’s Laurent Grill shares how a founder-first mindset is shaping venture investing and why differentiation, real-world impact and measurable outcomes matter more than ever.
